scene.title: Stack vs Queue
scene.summary: A stack removes the newest item (LIFO) while a queue removes the oldest (FIFO).

beats.title: Stack and Queue
beats.narration: A stack adds and removes at the same end (LIFO); a queue adds at the rear and removes from the front (FIFO).

beats.title: Push onto Stack
beats.narration: Push items A, B, C onto the stack; the newest item sits on top.

beats.title: Enqueue into Queue
beats.narration: Enqueue the same items; they line up with the first item at the front.

beats.title: Pop from Stack
beats.narration: Pop removes the most recent item, C, from the top of the stack.

beats.title: Dequeue from Queue
beats.narration: Dequeue removes the oldest item, A, from the front of the queue.
